patterns.seam: AppKit NSTextView pasteboard handling below the SwiftUI composer bridge
patterns.law: The Mac composer text view must own plain-text paste insertion directly; do not close a paste bug by relying only on SwiftUI commands, a main Edit menu, or implicit AppKit responder routing.

patterns.seam: AppKit pasteboard/responder chain -> SwiftUI composer state -> attachment chip -> worker context delivery
patterns.law: Image paste is not fixed by proving any one layer. Proof must traverse copied image/file URL -> focused composer paste gesture -> visible attachment chip -> SwiftUI state preserved -> send includes the attachment in worker context. If this recurs, build an isolation harness that mirrors the AppKit/SwiftUI seam before patching product code.
patterns.proof: Harness record plus targeted app tests: ComposerPasteboardReaderTests for image-first pasteboard precedence, focused composer paste/attachment integration for chip creation, and TeamRunAttachmentDeliveryTests for worker-context delivery.

patterns.seam: Any native/platform/product boundary where the full proof is not writable inside the current product path
patterns.law: When a repeated bug depends on native/platform behavior, stop in-place patching after two failed fixes and build a throwaway isolation harness that proves the primitive and seam before porting the delta back.
patterns.proof: Debugger packet must name `Attempt count`, `Seam`, `Isolation harness`, and the harness-to-product delta; future wall gate should fail repeated DEBUGLOG entries that omit them.

patterns.seam: Release launch fallback after live remote credentials are unavailable
patterns.law: Until remote sign-in is actually wired, any unauthenticated Release build must enter the supported dogfood preview/home path, not the dead sign-in/onboarding wall. Do not close this by clearing DerivedData, changing target selection, bumping the build number, or relying on App Store receipt filename alone; prove the release fallback policy.
